sacraments.text: Children up to 7. Register during pregnancy if possible; at least one practising Catholic parent. Four compulsory preparation sessions for parents/godparents; intake March/April, July/August, October/November in church. Register at least one month before first briefing and email birth certificate, parents’ baptism/church/marriage certificates, godparents’ baptism/church/marriage certificates where applicable. Max 2 godparents, one male/one female, confirmed practising Catholics 16+. Registration confirmed only after full documents received.
